entities.name: Customary & Indigenous Law
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Legal systems based on long-established customs, practices, and oral traditions of indigenous and local communities. Predating written law, customary law governed land tenure, marriage, dispute resolution, and resource management across Africa, Oceania, the Americas, and Asia for millennia.
